# A Canadian company borrows US dollars, buys US shares with them, and repays
# the loan in Canadian dollars at the year end. The share rises 50% and the US
# dollar falls from 1.40 to 1.25, so the two move against each other and the
# book has to carry both.
#
# What happens:
#
# - 2027-01-02  20,000.00 CAD of opening capital.
# - 2027-01-05  10,000.00 USD borrowed at 1.40. Stated in Canadian dollars, so
#               both sides get a cost: 14,000.00 CAD in the bank and
#               14,000.00 CAD of debt.
# - 2027-01-06  100 USD_CORP bought at 100.00 USD, stated wholly in US dollars.
#               The 10,000.00 USD leaves the bank's cost basis, which carries
#               1.40, so the shares cost 14,000.00 CAD — 140.00 a share. That
#               figure is in no split of this transaction: it comes out of the
#               cost basis the dollars were drawn from.
# - 2027-12-31  The loan repaid with Canadian dollars. The debt was taken on at
#               1.40 and 10,000.00 USD now costs 12,500.00 CAD, so settling it
#               realizes a gain of 1,500.00 CAD, which `$residual$` takes.
#
# What the year end says, and why each figure is what it is:
#
#     shares        100 at 150.00 USD at 1.25  =  18,750.00 CAD
#     their cost    100 at 140.00 CAD          =  14,000.00 CAD
#     unrealized                                   4,750.00 CAD
#
# That 4,750.00 carries both movements, which is the point of the case: the
# share is up 5,000.00 USD, worth 7,000.00 CAD at the rate it was bought at,
# and the dollar's fall from 1.40 to 1.25 takes 1,500.00 off the principal and
# 750.00 off the gain. 7,000.00 - 1,500.00 - 750.00 = 4,750.00.
#
#     assets        7,500.00 CAD + 18,750.00 CAD   =  26,250.00 CAD
#     liabilities   nothing, the loan is repaid
#     equity        20,000.00 opening + 1,500.00 retained + 4,750.00 unrealized
#
# and the two sides come to 26,250.00 each.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_us_shares_bought_with_a_us_loan_repaid_in_canadian_dollars.py.
2027-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2027-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2027-01-01 commodity USD_CORP
	mnemonic: "USD_CORP"
	fullname: "A company whose shares are priced in US dollars"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000

	type: "Asset"

	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"

		guid: "f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f00001"

		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "-14000.00"

2027-01-06 * "Buy 100 USD_CORP at 100.00 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Shares 100.0000 USD_CORP
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD_CORP"
		share_price: "100"
		value: "10000.00"
	Assets:USD Bank -10000.00 USD
		cost_basis_split_guid: "f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f00001"

2027-12-31 * "Repay the 10,000.00 USD loan with Canadian dollars"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Liabilities:USD Loan 10000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "14000.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f00002"
	Assets:CAD Bank -12500.00 CAD
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
